questions.q: With whose name do the genealogies of Chronicles begin?
Who prayed, "Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border"?
questions.evidence: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border

questions.q: "Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness" does what?
questions.evidence: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever

questions.q: Which city did David capture, taking the stronghold of Zion?
questions.evidence: Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there. The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion

questions.q: What did David do with the water his mighty men brought from Bethlehem?
questions.evidence: but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh

questions.q: What happened to Uzza when he put his hand on the ark?
questions.evidence: and he died there before God

questions.q: Nathan told David that who would build a house for God?
questions.evidence: who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom. He will build me a house

questions.q: What did Satan move David to do?
questions.evidence: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel

questions.q: What had David done that kept him from building the house himself?
questions.evidence: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars

questions.q: Which son did David say would build God's house?
questions.evidence: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts

questions.q: To whom does David say the greatness, the power and the glory belong?
questions.evidence: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty
